title: NIO Swaps 110,000 EV Batteries a Day. Why Doesn't America? #shorts

scenes.text: This electric car pulls in nearly empty and leaves full about three minutes later. No plug.
A robot under the floor unbolts the old battery and locks in a charged one.
China's NIO has done over a hundred thirty million swaps. Over a hundred ten thousand a day.
It has flopped before. Startup Better Place raised about eight hundred fifty million dollars, then went bankrupt in twenty thirteen.
Tesla swapped a battery in ninety seconds on stage. But of about two hundred owners invited, only four or five tried it.
The catch: cars must share one battery design, and someone must build thousands of stations. NIO has over four thousand.
Robot swap, or wait at a charger? Tell me below. Follow EV Drive.
